title: Choose the visual world for GoodNext
question: The roll assigned The Checkout Receipt. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Checkout Receipt
options.lineage: Milwaukee Public Library checkout receipts and due-date slips
options.thesis: Today's food options printed as a receipt you can carry: one line per place, a stamped check date on every one, nothing the printer cannot prove.
options.viewport: Phone: a narrow receipt column, GoodNext header and today's date printed top, the four-question form as fill-in lines, then today's options as printed entries with a highlighter band across each open window. The stamp in violet-blue reads CHECKED 2026-09-08 or CALL TO CONFIRM. Days two to seven are folded under a perforation line. Primary action: Print or Directions on each entry.
options.risk: Monospace on off-white drifts toward the generic 'receipt aesthetic' if the stamp and highlighter are timid; dense entries need strict column ruling or they read as a wall.

raised.raise: No color carries state alone: verified, call to confirm, and unconfirmed are stamped words, the color is secondary.
A 'now' tick sits on each entry's opening window so the resident sees whether the door is still open right now.
Uncertainty lines print as their own entries, never footnotes: 'Confirm they serve 53206' is a line item.
Days two to seven unfold one pull at a time under a perforation, stepped on small screens.
One strict character grid rules every line; nothing floats off the module.

options.label: The 7-Day Forecast Strip
options.thesis: Today is the big panel; the next six days are small tiles you can tap open, exactly the shape of the Bridge Plan.
options.viewport: Phone: a deep blue header with today's date and a giant count of open options, then white cards per option; below, a strip of six small day tiles. Primary action: Directions on each card.
options.risk: This is where most runs in this category land: today-big, six tiles, blue and white. Familiar and effective, and it risks reading as a weather app.

options.label: Warm Consumer App Surface
options.lineage: digital design canon: warm tinted ground, soft cards, one action color
options.thesis: Soft-cornered cards on a warm ground, plain labels, one bright color only where something can be pressed.
options.viewport: Phone: warm ground, white cards one per option, orange Directions button, persistent bottom bar.
options.case: Holds product clarity (action-only accent is a real discipline); loses audience identification because it is every app the resident has ever been asked to trust.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from a benefits portal or a delivery app.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Amber link lines on black glass, state drawn by stroke pattern, never hue.
options.viewport: Numbered lanes, each option tied to its default by an amber link line.
options.case: Loses identification (machine-room grammar) and clarity (black glass at a library terminal in daylight).

options.label: Drum Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Sixteen candy-colored step keys under a chase light that always shows where now is.
options.viewport: A timeline row you write into, the chase light marking now.
options.case: Loses both axes for an anxious resident; the 'now' marker is the one thing worth keeping.
options.kept: The chase light always tells you where now is.
options.risk: Playful where the moment is not.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.thesis: Achromatic text field with a hairline of mint, rose, violet marking the active band.
options.viewport: Wide white margins, color only at band edges.
options.case: Loses identification (a science instrument) and clarity (pastel hairlines fail contrast on a library screen).
options.kept: Uncertainty is a first-class state, marked explicitly.

options.label: Miura-Fold Sheet
options.thesis: A packet that unfolds in one pull into a precise creased field.
options.case: Loses both axes; the stepped unfold is the one discipline the receipt borrows for days two to seven.
options.risk: Aerospace spec grammar for a food pantry.

options.label: Studio Dumbar Identity
options.thesis: Saturated bars and vector fragments snapping to an invisible module over photographs.
options.viewport: Colored bars over a staged photo.
options.case: Loses both: loud identity grammar over a task a hungry person must finish in a minute.
options.kept: One strict module rules every element.
options.risk: Design-studio energy on a crisis screen.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What civic help sites ship: white page, blue header, card list, blue button, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Header, form, list of cards, footer with help numbers.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from a county benefits portal, the thing the site must not be mistaken for.
